description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Nihility Follow-Up] to the user, grants [PHY +30% Boost (15s)] to the user if user's ATK > MAG, grants or [Magical +30% Boost (15s)] to the user if user's MAG > ATK

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Nihility Follow-Up
description.text: Randomly casts Stormspell Strike, Meltdown or Taboo Raid after using a Dark ability
